QV-Active enables fully automatic non-contact and tactile measurements. Operator attendance during CNC measurement is not necessary, reducing labor costs. QV-Active can output in real-time measurement data to f.i. MeasurLink for statistical process control.

QV-Active is used in many kinds of industries and applications. Because of its high-resolution color camera, zoom optical system with interchangeable lenses, and the retrofittable touch probe, it is a very powerful multi-sensor vision measuring machine.

With an accuracy of about 3 microns in all 3 axes, its high-resolution color camera, zoom optical system with interchangeable lenses, and the retrofittable touch probe option, it fulfills the requirements of many customers in f.i. electronical-, medical-, metal working- and plastics industry.
